scope: Actual iOS16 eapolclient SET3 WEP/MSK/PMKSA fields, association20 PMK/passphrase fields, native EAPOL AF_NDRV registration and authenticated completion interest endpoint. Typed strict parser and registration codec; runtime integration and WPA2-PSK handshake engine not implemented.

artifact.wrapper: Existing address-preserving offline ELF; original binary is neither patched nor executed. Existing retained REA analysis reused.

native_evidence.contract: Initial request is zeroed; req.type at16 receives selector. Case3 requires nonnull param4 and param5==0x94. Forwards original pointer with length148 to IOCTLSetWrapper. No field extraction, PMK/PTK/GTK semantics or authenticated-success signal is established by this case. The implemented subset accepts value0 from this producer and rejects other values.

Existing retained wrapper analysis establishes ARM64 SET request0x802869c8 and common request fields. The new carrier is consumed only after the existing credential-checked bounded copyin adapter. It does not accept or dereference a user pointer.

Bounded case-insensitive procedure-name search Key|Cipher|EAPOL|SetWithIOCTL|Controlled|Port in the existing IO80211 target. Found SetWithIOCTL; no named EAPOL/key/controlled-port producer was identified. This is not evidence of absence of code or an ABI proof.
Actual SET3 producer zeroes148, version32@0=1; len32@4=5/13; cipher32@8=1/2; flags16@12 from native input table1,2,5,9; index16@14 from argument; key bytes@16. No CCMP producer inferred.

Actual SET3 zeroed148, version1; len0 or64@4, secret@16; cipher7 with six-byte supplied BSSID@92, cipher9 without BSSID. Flag/index/counter/tail zero. Called as wireless_set_wpa_msk from FUN_10000c8c0, not a PTK/TK16 setter.

Actual association592 rootlocal_2c8 embeds key rootlocal_290 at56. version1, len32@key+4 and cipher6@key+8 with32-byte parsed PMK@key+16; alternative cipher10 with passphrase@key+16 and actual length. Parser supports strict PMK32 or8..63 passphrase with unsupported extension bytes rejected. This does NOT prove direct SET3 PMK/CCMP carriers.

Native transmit refreshes unknown BSSID before sending and refuses TX if still absent. Actual GET9 six-byte BSSID; GET1 SSID; CopyValue2 AUTH_UPPER. This is association metadata BEFORE port authorization; no GET103 dependency inferred.

Observed native socket arguments27/3/0, sockaddr18 with family27 and ifname16; nonblocking ioctl; setsockopt level0 option4 with24-byte protocol version1/family0x8021ec/count1 or2/pointer@16. Each32-byte demux entry type16=4/length16=2, network-order EtherTypes888e and wireless88c7. Exact fields corroborate pinned Apple eapol_socket.c. Unused union bytes are malloc data and MUST NOT be required zero.

Uses existing stdin when fstat reports a socket; otherwise calls imported _eapol_socket(ifname,is_wireless). Registers FD handler callback FUN_10000da40 and EAPOLClientAttach. A listener is not proven to be running merely by adding DLIL input.

IOBSDNameMatching(ifname), walks two IOService parents, IOGeneralInterest callback; only message0xe0000130 calls 4-way-handshake-complete callback. It is not SET3 return success. Do not send this until actual authenticated handshake and genuine key/TX confirmations.

source_contracts.contract: Existing board-owned WPA2-PSK/CCMP128 descriptor-v2 subset. EtherType0x888e, actual associated AP/station addresses, Ethernet14..1514; pairwise EAPOL M1/M3 RX and M2/M4 TX only. New preflight uses the existing actual MIC verifier and phase/replay/deadline checks. It does not advance phase, mark TX_DONE, install a key or authorize a port.

Existing typed eapol/install_key/authorize functions remain separate. Transport completion is not authentication. SET3 must never call authorize merely because a key was accepted. Production key decoding and native supplicant transport/completion require separate evidence and integration.

Existing backend's MediaTek gen3 CMD_802_11_KEY, ADD_PKEY_DONE, TX_DONE and Ethernet HIF framing derive from this pinned board source. No new firmware encoding or crypto algorithm is copied into these adapters.

Compared only as a source reference. Its key fields and flag mapping are not established for this iOS artifact by the retained SET3 function. No field mapping or its immediate RSN_HANDSHAKE_DONE behavior is copied.

Copied primary Apple source, not cloned. Version equality with iOS16 not assumed; native REA observations above corroborate these paths. wireless.c contains no implementation; wireless.h/m empty, so public source alone cannot establish native key ABI.

integration_limits: Existing NativeRendezvous drops RX kind2 and registers verifier null. Existing BSD input/output also require authorized datapath_ready; native AF_NDRV control traffic needs a distinct pre-authorization path tied to real association and exact EAPOL type/addresses, not ordinary IP admission.

XNU bsd/net/ndrv.c actually attaches copied demux descriptors with ifnet_attach_protocol and ndrv_input finds matching ifnet/protocol family and prepends14-byte Ethernet header. BSD bridge uses ether_demux/ether_add_proto. Native socket registration is now artifact-proven, but runtime listener presence is unobserved.

CurrentRecord/GET21 open-only gating belongs to another owner. Actual eapolclient demands GET9/1/2 while unauthorized; secure association and port authorization must remain separate. No native GET103 dependency established.

Actual eapolclient SET3 producers are WEP and MSK/PMKSA (enterprise path). WPA2-Personal uses association PMK/passphrase. No PTK16/cipher5 producer discovered; the parser rejects that unproven mapping. Existing MT6630 CCMP backend therefore cannot consume these as ready TK keys.

A genuine WPA2-PSK handshake/crypto owner remains required from supplied PMK/passphrase, with real KCK/MIC/GTK unwrap and backend event confirmations. verifier null cannot be changed to unconditional success. No SET3 or registration parser authorizes anything.

Typed parser supports only observed fields and strict zero extensions; keys are owned and explicitly clearable, never logged. No runtime wiring, existing-owner source changes, console/tty/sampler edits, native Apple binary patch, hardware/SSH/mtk or SDK build.
credit: Original board adapter code; retained REA evidence and existing project security backend are referenced. No third-party implementation or Apple code bytes are embedded.
